also: you’re putting it on a little thick

terms.gloss: rather tiresome, a bit over the top (of talk)
terms.grammar: adjective, diminutive of the comparative of pūtidus
evidence: Cic. Fam. 7.5.3 (Lewis & Short: “of discourse, rather more tedious or troublesome”)
Traupman 106: you’re putting it on a little thick, es pūtidiusculus
terms.comment: From pūtidus, rotten, hence of style “affected, overdone”. The word is Cicero’s, from a letter, and rare.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 106, each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.: p. 311.
